thread:
Rowan: FYI opened PR to unify SDK examples for audit exports + SOC2 phrasing. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/501. Need legal + ops review.
Naveen: quick note: examples use 'redact=true' but legal wants 'pseudonymize=true' term. also missing Swift snippet for mobile SDK parity.
Priya: agree on taxonomy. SOC2 language: avoid 'may' for controls. propose: 'Audit logs contain tenant and actor identifiers necessary for troubleshooting. Exported logs intended for analytics MUST be pseudonymized or excluded per customer configuration.'
Marta (docs): updated wording and swapped 'redact' -> 'pseudonymize' in code samples. added Python, JS, and Swift snippets. Swift sample: ```swift
Redwood.audits.export(orgId: "org-abc", pseudonymize: true, retentionDays: 180)
```
Rowan: can we add a tiny curl example and an inline JSON sample showing pseudonymized payload?
Marta (docs): added both. curl: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST \n  -d '{"pseudonymize": true, "since": "2024-01-01"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export
``` JSON sample: `{"actor_id": "pseud_0a1b", "event": "deploy"}`
ops-bot: Reminder: Reprocessing historical exports can impact I/O and billing. Schedule maintenance window; recommend incremental batches. See https://internal.redwood/ops/export-runbook
Naveen: also added a Terraform provider snippet for toggling pseudonymization so infra customers can opt in: ```hcl
resource "redwood_audit_policy" "p" {
  org_id = "org-abc"
  export_pseudonymize = true
  retention_days = 180
}
```
docs-bot: Automated check failed: missing SOC2 control mapping table (CC7/CC8). Please add mapping or mark N/A.
Priya: I'll drop a minimal mapping table that ties the export behavior to CC7 evidence. Keep it short and link to controls doc.
Marta (docs): pushed commit with mapping table, added a short auditor checklist (what to provide, sample logs, timestamps). request final signoff.
Rowan: legal + ops ack in thread, merging after CI. thanks everyone! :tada:
